features.name: Renderer ownership and composition convergence
features.behavior: RenderComposition owns renderer feature and pass bundles behind narrow services, SceneRenderer orchestrates immutable frame data instead of caching mutable feature/pass pointers, and a new feature can be composed without extending a central hard-coded pass list.
acceptanceCriteria: RenderComposition is the sole construction owner for built-in renderer features and their pass bundles; SceneRenderer no longer constructs the built-in pass list.
Feature adapters do not retain mutable RenderPassRegistry, IRenderPass, or concrete pass pointers; cross-feature exchange uses typed graph resources and immutable frame plans.
SceneRenderer remains the frame orchestrator but no longer caches built-in feature adapter pointers or concrete built-in pass pointers for composition-time wiring.
Forward+, Deferred, Hybrid RT, particles, water, transparency, post-process, and existing execution receipts remain behaviorally equivalent.
A fail-closed architecture checker rejects reintroduction of central built-in pass construction or mutable pass pointer ownership in feature adapters.

features.name: Graphics qualification and production PBR showcases
features.behavior: RenderQualityLab and deterministic model/PBR showcases consume only cooked assets while the material product advances to one strict V2 contract with production glTF extension semantics shared by Forward+ and Deferred; completion-owned visual evidence remains configuration-bound, and fixed-GPU plus remote qualification is executed after the GFX25 implementation stabilizes.
acceptanceCriteria: RenderQualityLab is a deterministic cooked-only Sample scenario that uses only public World, Entity, Light, Camera, asset, profile, and diagnostics contracts and never reaches RHI, RenderGraph, or renderer-private APIs.

One immutable qualification capture bundle binds BeautyLDR, PreToneHDR, LinearDepth, Normal, Velocity, AO, and Reactive attachments to the exact frame/view/scene/configuration identity and graph provenance.
Capture readback is submission-completion owned and polled without WaitIdle; missing, partial, stale, duplicate, or cross-frame attachments fail the entire bundle closed.
Visual qualification supports per-attachment ROI policies, mean and maximum absolute error, PSNR, SSIM, diff heatmaps, and deterministic temporal flicker after warmup.

Performance qualification separates warmup from at least 300 completion-owned samples and records CPU phases, the conservative Graphics qualification span, ordered per-pass GPU timing, upload bytes, memory classes, and post-warmup resource-growth invariants against exact hardware baselines.
A dedicated GFX24 required suite validates the scenario, bundle, metrics, budgets, provenance, Shipping closure, and evidence schema without fabricating unsupported cross-platform results.

MaterialStaticDescriptor V2 and CookedMaterialArtifact V2 carry specular, clearcoat, transmission, volume, IOR, and emissive-strength semantics through deterministic cook and strict runtime load with no V1 reader.
Forward+ and Deferred consume one canonical material table and BRDF contract; clearcoat is a separately gated lobe and unsupported source workflows fail closed.
model-viewer and pbr-materials are deterministic cooked-only qualification scenarios with real execution receipts, stable camera bookmarks, and no runtime importer or shader compiler closure.
The approved GFX24 DX12 Goldens remain required; fixed-GPU A4 and Windows/Linux/macOS plus DX12/Vulkan RT qualification run after GFX25 implementation as one final evidence closure.

Focused tests, Architecture, complete Windows Debug Build Truth, DX12 qualification, Shipping cooked-only closure, and diff hygiene pass; Linux Vulkan and macOS Metal remain explicit PR-CI obligations.
